avis.titre: The only cleanser I will use.

This is the best cleanser! It makes a really creamy lather that is almost like a cream cleanser, but a creamy, lathery one, and it rinses off so well, leaving my skin soft and not dry. This is a winner!
I was excifed for this and it really me out. I hadn't broken out in over a year, used this for 3-4 says, and then had cysts under my skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.

This is a really nice cleanser. It's gentle & it cleans the skin well. It leaves my skin feeling soft & smooth. I don't see anything that is "anti- aging" about it. I don't see a difference in any fine lines or wrinkles. It is a really nice cleanser, though. I received this complimentary for my honest review.

I like the consistency of the product. The smells is pleasant. It leaves my face feeling baby softand clean. I feel less agging after use. I would but this product and recommend it.

This cleanser is amazing. I love Origins but I love it even more after using Plantscription Anti-Aging Claenser. It is phthalate-free, sulfate-free and paraben-free. A small amount goes a long way. I wanted to use this as directed so I washed my face AM and PM with it for a few days. This proved to be too strong for my dry skin, so I went back to using it only at night and then had no problems. I don't notice much in terms of anti aging but I've only been using it for a couple of weeks. I will continue to use it but this is a bit too strong for an everyday facial item in my skin carotene.

I really was glad to find this anti-aging cleanser by Orgins. Ever since I started using it I noticed my skin is a lot firmer and aging is less visible. From the moment you apply it you ca feel it's working. Very easy to apply and does not irritate my skin . This is definitely a must in my beauty routine.

Might not be the best for dry skin but amazing for oily or combination skin. My face feels more youthful after use. Only thing is that is does make your face feel a little tight but I like it so much that its easy to look past.

Firstly, I absolutely love the how my skin felt after using this cleanser. It was very creamy and I the foaming. It really gives me that clean feel without being dry. I love it.

Origins Plantscription Anti-Aging Cleanser foams up nicely and easily took off all of my makeup. My skin felt clean, smooth and hydrated afterwards.

I have been using Origins Plantscription Anti-Aging Cleanser for about 3 weeks, and I am in love with it! My skin is now so smooth, I can't help but run my fingers across my cheeks atleast once a day! I have also noticed that I have a more even skin tone and no redness or blotchiness. All in all, the Origins Plantscription Anti-Aging Cleanser is a fantastic product and I highly recommend it.!

I love this product. A little goes a long way. Its moisturizing, so it doesnt strip your skin. But cleans effectively.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again...
avis.texte: It pains me to write this review, but I am compelled to make others aware. Let me begin with I liked the cleanser; I really liked how it lathered and my face felt clean after each wash. That being said, I was disappointed with the packaging. I purchased the 8.5oz container and half way through its use the opening clogged. I made the hole larger and it clogged repeatedly. With the larger hole the cap would not stay closed, which I sure aided in the subsequent clogs. Even worse, I travel often and I could not take this cleanser with me. SO, because I am a loyal Origins customer I purchased a second container, this time the 5 oz, thinking the size was the problem. NOPE, same result. Now, I have two more than half used container that I eventually threw away. Frustrated, I reached out to Origins via email, shared my concern and encouraged them to fix the packaging and/or to give me some guidance on whether my use was causing the problem. I received a response apologizing for my poor experience and then they offered (no, I did not ask for replacements) to send me replacements, but for this to occur I had to send them the very small serial numbers etched in the seam at the bottom, and was the same color and very, very tiny (to my 50 year old eyes :-)). I complied. I guess they wanted to ensure I did not buy a KNOCKOFF - I did not realize there was such a thing. It has now been over 90 days and I have neither received the unsolicited replacements nor have I heard anything else from t

I recently purchased two bottles of this because my last two in the old packaging ran out. I have been using this product for years. Unfortunately, it seems like the formula has changed. It now takes more product to get my face clean than the tiny amount it took before. It does not foam up like it used to. This formula smells different, smells more floral, and has a waxy texture on the face. I will no longer buy this product.
I have tried this product for 1 week and I can tell the different in my skin texture. Love the clean feeling it leaves.

And to be honest, it always felt like such a mess, with water and cleanser dripping off my face. But this stuff is awesome! It only needs a little water to foam up, and it is just like kind of frothy lotion, staying right on my face, no dripping. You only need a little bit. And then I wipe it off with the wipes. My skin feels clean without feeling stripped. Then I do the nighttime serum, retinol, then lifting cream, Eye doctor on my eyes, and I'm all set! Plantscriptions comes through again!

avis.titre: Yes im buying this again for sure
avis.texte: I use everytime i need to wash face. Just need a tiny bit and thats more than enough. Love it.

My skin is oily, but extremely sensitive with rosacea, so it can be difficult to find the right product that works with all of those issues. I need cleanser that leaves my face clean and dewy, but not at the expense of a product that just "sits on top" or leaves my face on fire. I tried Origins' Checks and Balances, but the product left my face with that "squeaky" tight feel. Then I tried this this cleanser. Total revelation. When I mountain bike, my regimen is plenty of oil-free moisterizer, anti-aging serum, and oil-free high SPF sunscreen as I am in the sun at least 50% of the time. When I come home, my once clean face is an absolute a hot mess. My moisterizer, serum, and sunscreen now also harbors dirt, dust, sweat, and grime. However, I can always count on this cleanser to take EVERYTHING off with ONE application including my neck and decollete. In fact, the more I lightly massage in the cleanser, the foamier it gets (and I only use a pea-sized amount). The best part? My skin isn't RED or irritated after I use it. It isn't "squeaky" or tight, it's soft and clean. I hope Origins never, ever fudges with the ingredients of this cleanser or starts charging more for less. Because, for me (and I hope for you!), it's truly one-of-a-kind!

The best origins cleanser ever! I used it for years now! It does not dry out your skin. Would highly recommend it!

avis.titre: Hands down the best cleanser EVER!
avis.texte: I am a 41yo military spouse with Rosacea. I have no lines or wrinkles. I want to keep it that way. We move every 2-4 years, wherever our new home is I have had to change my skincare routine to accommodate the new climate/weather. I do not have to switch cleansers. I have been using this cleanser for a few years. And I love it! Here's why: On a daily basis every morning I use a face moisturizer, a SPF 70 Sunblock, a face primer, and face powder. This cleanser is the first cleanser I have used that takes EVERYTHING off the 1st time and DOES NOT dry out my skin or make it red/blotchy or breakout. It makes my skin feel clean, soft, and hydrated. Other cleansers have made my face red, and feel tight and dry after use. I have tried too many cleanser to list, from dr prescribed to drugstore brand to high end brands. I will definitely be purchasing Planscriptions Anti-Aging Cleanser again & again & again!
It was recommend to me. I like how creamy and clean it feels.
My skin feels clean and moisturized . I am hoping to see continued improvement for lines and wrinkles

avis.titre: Beware of the Cleansers that may harm the eye...
avis.texte: I had been using this for awhile, when one day I got some in my eye (maybe my eyes were more susceptible as I had a bout of hayfever.) I had never experienced so much pain in my eyes, I was afraid to even look at it (I could barely open the eye). When I called Origins and asked if there was ANY cleansers that were safe, the rep. put me on hold and said her manager said (and I had suggested that) Cleansing Make Up Removing Jelly which you can use to remove eye makeup, on my own (I checked every one) there was ANTIOXIDANT CLEANSER WITH WHITE TEA, which says it was Ophthalmologist tested (which the Jelly does not say, I guess the manager assumed because you can use it to remove eye makeup s/he thought it would be safe around eyes.) Some of them say do not use around the eyes, so in case you do get it in accidentally, I would NOT use them. Warning: I had bought this as part of one of their combo Xmas packages, was told I could only get a refund if I returned the whole kit, am not sure I have all the pieces. I am not interested in a refund, would rather substitute for another cleanser, hopefully when a manager calls me back, I can work it out, wish Origins had a forum.
This product is awesome. I have extremely oily skin and luv how this smooths my face. I was doing a Korean double cleansing and it does not cone close to this cleanser.

I use this product daily and I love it. I have tried other products and this one by far the best I've ever used. My skin really feels clean and smooth every time. A small amount goes a long way. My husband also uses it while showering and loves it as well. I am in my 40's and my skin looks and feels youthful. I highly recommend this product and the Plantscription product line. I will use Plantscriptions for a lifetime.

avis.titre: Works great even on young skin
avis.texte: I'm only 22 years old, so I don't necessarily need an anti-aging cleanser but I LOVE this product. I have very oily skin, and this is the first cleanser I've found that keeps my face shine-free all day. I used to have lots of acne scars/discoloration on my cheeks, and the spots have almost completely disappeared. This stuff is amazing.

I just recently came back to Origins after a long hiatus, and this cleanser is absolutely marvelous for my 50+ year-old combination skin. It lathers beautifully and cleanses well without drying-out my skin. My face is glowing for the first time in years! I use the Plantscription cleanser, lotion, serum, lifting cream, eye cream and overnight mask. What a lovely product line! I am truly loving my skin for the first time in a long while...

I am 37, and don't write reviews but this one deserves one!! I suffer from Lupus, and have challenges with my skin and don't mind investing in skin care if it works.. with that said, I have used MANY different high end products, and this one, hands down beats them all! You won't be disappointed!! The price and value are unbeatable! This will leave your face glowing, and makeup applies smoother! Must try!!

My skin looks brighter and there's definitely an improvement in elasticity. I use it every morning in the shower with my clarisonic, and overall it is not irritating my sensitive skin. My eyes were not so lucky, pretty uncomfortable. But the discomfort passes, and I like the results.

As a woman approaching her mid-30's I was in need of a new product that works for my super dry skin and my resent pop-up of "expression lines". This is so nice on the skin and doesn't dry my face out even more like other cleansers. I love it so far!

The cleanser is creamy and smooth, yet foamy enough like Checks and Balances to remove stubborn makeup (even mascara). I use this product in the evenings with the Origins Mini Facial Brush to cleanse my face and neck and cannot recommend it enough. A little goes a long way and it's never too early to start combating the signs of aging with the Plantscription line. If you're looking for a foamy, yet creamy cleanser that's gentle and also effective, look no further.
I've been using this cleanser for a year and I love love love how my skin feels after every use. It's really perfect! !

Unfortunately, this product hasn't been able to combat my acne. I am 35 years old and just started getting acne. After purchasing and using this product for several weeks, I finally decided to toss the remaining product and go back to my old routine. I am afraid to try another Origins cleanser due to cost, if it can't battle my adult acne.

A little goes a long way with this cleanser! I decided to try this out because it is dermatologist recommended to start anti-aging regimens after 21 years of age, and this cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean. A little dry, but clean.
love the feeling after using this. my skin is tight and clean! a little does go a long way. almost like a facial in every wash! can't wait to buy more
love the feeling after using this. my skin is tight and clean! a little does go a long way. almost like a facial in every wash! can't wait to buy more

I bought this with skepticism. I have the driest of skin but I hate it when it's too thick. This makes my skin very clean and moisturized. I haven't had a face wash that is quite so moisturizing while still giving you that fresh clean feeling. I would highly recommend it. Also a little goes a long way!! A small dab will do.

I recently got this to try. I used to use Checks and Balances but it dries my face out and made it feel extremely tight. Reading the reviews on plantscription made me nervous because it seems some had the same issue as I did with C&B. I'm happy to report that Plantscription did not dry me out! It made my skin soft, clean and smooth!

I have been using Plantscription anti-aging cleanser morning and night for more than a year. It cleans my face well and it's gentle to my sensitive skin. Plus, I never have dry skin issues after washing!

This product definitely delivers on its promise of removing dirt and dead skin. It's not overly harsh and smells great. If you are looking for a super moisturizing cleanser, this one probably isn't for you but if you are looking for a high-quality daily grime remover, I highly recommend it!
I love this cleanser it is rich and creamy. It gives my skin a deep clean without striping it dry. I have recently moved to a dryer climate and this couldn't have come at a better time.

I chose this because it said it was good for dry skin, when really my skin was just even dryer after using it. I really think this should be suggested to the ones that struggle with oily skin as opposed to dry. Also my skin felt like it does after I clean with bar soap (can't stand bar soap because of this feeling), it's like a dry sticky feeling, hard to describe, just not soft. Bummed out this drys out my skin.
It cleans my face so well at night! Feels fresh clean and tight! As with many of their face cleansers, a little goes a long way!
